title: The Brückner Group – a global technology company - K Trade Fair
content: ##### Brückner Group GmbH. # The Brückner Group – a global technology company. The Brückner Group has been a family-owned company since it was established in 1960. It stands for technological expertise and the highest quality in the field of machinery and installations for the production and processing of plastics and other packaging materials. * Brückner Group: Strategic management holding and management company for all business areas of the Brückner Group. * Brückner Maschinenbau: World market leader in production installations for the manufacture of films for high-quality packaging material and technical applications. * Kiefel: The leader in serial and special machinery for the processing of plastics in the automobile, refrigeration, medical technology and packaging industries. * PackSys Global: Global player for special machines for the packaging industry. The companies within the group operate independently but share a focus on engineering as their core added value as well as their striving for leadership in technology and on the world market in their individual segments.

title: Brueckner Maschinenbau GmbH
content: The Battery Show North America 2025German Exhibitors Brueckner Maschinenbau GmbH. # Brueckner Maschinenbau GmbH. www.brueckner-maschinenbau.com/en. Brückner Maschinenbau is part of the family-owned Brückner Group, Germany, and is the world's leading supplier of lines for the production of oriented plastic films. Brückner’s lines guarantee international film manufacturers efficient, flexible and profitable film production of all types. * Battery separator film line concepts guaranteeing high energy efficiency, low production costs and consistent film quality. * Sequential as well as simultaneous stretching lines to manufacture extremely thin and high-temperature capacitor films for EV and renewable energy applications in the power industry. The company's range of services includes planning, construction and commissioning of complete production lines and plants as well as all process and mechanical engineering developments for film production. E-mail: sales@brueckner.com. Internet: www.brueckner-maschinenbau.com/en. E-mail: info@brueckner-usa.com. E-mail: Stefan.Koenigsreuther@brueckner.com. * Lines and components for battery separator film, capacitor film and current collector film. * Capacitor film lines for ultra-thin film production and high output.

title: History and High Points - Brückner Group
content: What began as a medium-sized enterprise has grown into a global technology leader with firm roots, sustainable growth, and a spirit of curiosity and openness. Our four specialized business units – Brückner Maschinenbau, Brückner Servtec, Hennecke, Kiefel, and PackSys Global – bring together in-depth expertise in film manufacturing, servicing, industrial processing of PUR, thermoforming, and packaging. The founding of Paul Kiefel GmbH marks the first chapter in the story of a company that would become an integral part of the Brückner Group. What began as a small mechanical engineering firm laid the foundation for decades of technological expertise in plastic processing. In the following decades, the company evolves from a purely manufacturing business into a global engineering firm. With the inception of Brückner Far East, the company takes a visionary step into Asian markets. With Brückner Colombia, the Group takes its global presence into South America for the first time.

title: Brückner Maschinenbau
content: The Brückner Group is a family-owned consortium specializing in machine manufacturing and customized engineering solutions and services for the plastics and packaging industry. # For Your Plastic Film of Tomorrow. We are the world’s leading supplier of production lines for the manufacture of stretched films – used as finest packaging material or in high-tech applications. With cutting-edge solutions, a globally unique Technology Center, and deep insight into market needs, we help shaping production environments that are powerful, efficient, and built for lasting success across the entire value chain. ## Always in the Interests of our Customers. Market and feasibility studies, financing, film development, digital solutions or services - we help you in all project phases and - together with Brückner Servtec - throughout the entire life cycle. Thanks to our credo “Stretching the Limits”, as a film manufacturer you benefit from the combined know-how of our experts - whether in mechanical engineering, process engineering or software development.
